title: Moose's Varied Wildflowers
description: This addon to the MooseCraft family of resource packs adds three new color variations for wildflowers to give your forests more life and color!
body:
## How do you get more whimsical than blocks made by a Moose?
Well, you have that Moose make color variants for wildflowers! This small addon pack for the MooseCraft family of resource packs, adds a subtle 3d model to wildflowers and adds 3 new color combinations: cyan and orange, red and purple, and blue and magenta. This small change adds a rainbow of color to your birch forests to make them even more whimsical! 


This pack can also be used as a standalone pack and is compatible with other packs as long as this pack is placed above any packs that modify wildflowers.

### Check out the rest of the MooseCraft family of resource packs, including:
- [MooseCraft](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/moose-craft): Combines all of the packs (excluding this pack and flowering vines)
- [Moose Items](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/moose-items): Adds 3d item models to almost every item in the game!
- [Moose UI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mooseui): Overhaul to Minecraft's UI with support for OptiGUI!
- [Moose Mobs](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/moosemobs): Updating many of Minecraft's Mobs to the MooseCraft art style!
